nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: A mysterious hooded figure reveals themselves to be a benevolent alien with translucent blue skin and three eyes arranged in a triangle pattern. The alien has no visible hair and wears organic-looking armor that pulses with bio-energy. The camera angle is a dramatic reveal shot, pulling back as the hood falls away. The lighting is ethereal white from above, as if from an alien sun, casting gentle shadows that emphasize the alien's unique features. The scene appears to be mystical sci-fi encounter footage.
